beats.headline: Like the Hangover movie
beats.text: One more item of note comes out of a Gold Adventurer Box: a pink backpack thing. Donut sniffs it and says it looks like one of those BabyBjörn baby backpacks from the Hangover movie, and asks whether Carl and his new wife have already had a honeymoon. That is exactly what it is, says Carl, except it only carries quadrupeds. It is for carrying her on his chest, and if he wears it with her buckled in, his Phase or Oozy spell will phase her too. Donut is absolutely not getting in. Does she look like a milk-soaked toddler? Carl laughs. It might come in handy someday.

beats.headline: The backpack is done
beats.text: With seventy-five minutes on the countdown on every screen, and crumbs and wrappers all over the room, Carl lays a patch, a gun, a sewing kit and a holster out on the table and asks out loud whether Mordecai got the chance to make the carrier thing. Mordecai answers in chat. The backpack is done, and it is sitting on Carl's crafting table. Carl thanks him and starts sewing a patch onto his jacket.

beats.headline: A pig on his chest
beats.text: Carl pulls open the back of the truck. A sluggalo is on fire, and Penelope is eating a fully cooked chicken sandwich, already wearing the front part of the harness. He only has to slip his arms through. He steps out wearing the enormous, struggling pig against his chest: the special backpack from the start of the tenth floor, meant for Donut so he could take a quadruped through his movement spells, modified by Mordecai to fit the giant pig, whose legs wave in the air. She squeals. Even at his strength it is a struggle.

beats.headline: Unhooked in front of a god
beats.text: In Oozy Form, thanks to the magic of the carrier, Penelope becomes part of Carl as he slimes through Scolopendra's insides, and he does not want to think about how that works. Inside the club, with the floor rumbling and Emberus in front of them, he activates Sticky Feet, tells Penny not to move and promises her more splooge, unhooks the backpack and gently sets her on the floor, then steps aside so she is out of the line of fire.
